title: Control Core
reference: repeat 5 { while not wall_ahead { if box_ahead { jump jump } else { forward } if on_switch { activate } } turn_right }
hints: The core spirals inward: crates to hop, switches to throw, and nothing evenly spaced.
Walk each side with a while. Inside: hop a crate or step forward, then activate if on a switch. Turn right at each wall.
repeat 5 { while not wall_ahead { if box_ahead { jump jump } else { forward } if on_switch { activate } } turn_right }

story.intro: VANTA: "The Control Core. Every sensor in this tower reports to me. Come and look."
story.outro: PATCH: "Control Room's ours. Only the roof is left. VANTA's up there, and so is the way out."
